cart.title: Welcome to Thunder Mountain Curry!
cart.subtitle: Our Story
cart.description: From our beginnings out of a hot dog cart to the RPI Student Union, the Troy Waterfront Farmer's Market, and our Pandemic Pop-Ups, TMC has never wavered from our mission - to bring the Troy, NY community a mouth-watering culinary adventure straight from the streets. Our new journey takes us back to our roots as a true street food experience. Follow us on Instagram and FaceBook to see where we're serving today!
cart.SubsectionDescription: Thunder Mountain Curry focuses on quality ingredients and authentic Pan-Asian recipes with our own twist. TMC is a unique street food experience for those seeking a delicious and satisfying culinary adventure.
cart.SubsectionDescription2: Now at the Troy Waterfront Farmers Market and in front of the RPI Student Union - follow us to find out when!
